expectations.text: B1: Coaches not dumps: gives a staged milestone plan / scaffold with TODOs, not a complete final implementation

expectations.text: B3: Technically specific to this tutorial (regex-engine-regex-c): milestones match the tutorial's actual stages, language and key concepts, not generic boilerplate
